info.title: Synod development API
info.description: Development API for device enrollment, app discovery, destinations, approval, backups, protection plans, and operation inspection. Account and session endpoints are not described here yet.

post.description: Save settings and queue delivery. This does not check storage or start a backup. Reuse the destination ID and exact input for a retry. A removed ID cannot be reused. Input is limited to 32 KiB.

delete.description: Remove settings. Keep repository data. Offline agents remove cached credentials after reconnect. Repeated removal has no effect.

post.description: Save an immutable backup request. The agent starts it after destination settings arrive. Read /v1/operations/{id} for its state and result. A client disconnect does not cancel the backup.

put.description: Confirm the reviewed revision and save choices atomically. Offline agents apply changes when settings arrive. Admitted work continues. Snapshots remain after an opt-out.

post.description: Save an immutable app restore request. The source app can be absent. The target device must be approved. With no snapshot ID, use the latest available snapshot. With no destination ID, check all destinations available to the target. Read /v1/operations/{id} for progress. A client disconnect does not cancel the restore.

get.description: Read a file or a tar archive. Streaming clients must check the final X-Synod-Transfer: complete trailer. With verified=1, Synod verifies up to 64 MiB in memory before sending a body. Two verified downloads can run at once. Check the X-Synod-Transfer: complete header and the Content-Length in this mode.

enrollmentBearer.description: A scoped, one-use enrollment token. Generate 32 random bytes and encode them as canonical unpadded base64url.

adminSession.name: __Host-synod_session
adminSession.description: An authenticated administrator session. Unsafe requests must supply a matching Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin.

csr_der.description: DER Ed25519 CSR. Retain these exact bytes and the local private key through retries.

destination_address.description: The destination service host and port. Empty before advertisement.

node_id.description: Required for local and Synod-device paths. The device must be approved. A Synod-device destination needs an advertised listener.

current.description: The current agent session saved this revision.

known.description: True for a filesystem report no more than five minutes old.

id.description: Use the same ID and input for a retry.

restart_pending.description: Containers that the agent must restart before it can finish.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone. Local is not accepted.

id.description: Keep this ID and input for retries.

ProtectionUpdate.description: Use all or nonempty app_ids. All also sets automatic protection for new apps. Settings are required when enabled. Omitted destination choices are allowed only when protection is off.

settings_current.description: The current source session saved the current plan revision.

data_loss_window_seconds.description: Seconds since the latest good snapshot started. Absent when no good copy was reported.

restore_tested_at.description: Completion time of the last successful isolated drill. Later failures do not erase this date.

replace.description: Save a safety snapshot before replacing a matching target app. Unrelated conflicts are refused.

recovery_pending.description: Original containers that need recovery before the operation can finish.

ProofSubmission.description: Integrity checks require destination_id and forbid app_id and snapshot_id. Restore drills require app_id. A drill uses the latest snapshot unless snapshot_id is set.

url.description: Private Shoutrrr URL. An empty URL disables sends. Use ntfy, gotify, discord, slack, smtp, or generic.
